title: Errors that clean up
description:
Open several resources and release all of them on every error path.

```
copy ok: 18 bytes
missing input: error 2 (No such file or directory), nothing leaked
bad output path: error 2, input closed, buffer freed
```
hints: `if (!(in = fopen(from, "rb"))) { err = errno; goto cleanup; }` and the same pattern for each step (lesson 7.04).
At `cleanup:`, `free(buffer)` and close each file only `if` it is not `NULL`; `free(NULL)` is allowed.
requirements: `int copy_file(const char *from, const char *to)` returns 0 or an `errno` value.
Use one cleanup section at the end with `goto cleanup` and resources set to `NULL` at the start.
Allocate a buffer with `malloc`, open both files, copy with `fread` and `fwrite`, and check every call.
stretch: Write the copy to a temporary name and `rename` it into place only after everything succeeded.
